history.summary: FLAG - UNCERTAIN IDENTITY: no temple named exactly 'Kali Bari Temple' was found documented in Bhagalpur (the one detailed 'Kali Bari Mandir' history found online is in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - not Bhagalpur). Bhagalpur city has several Kali shrines (Barmasia Kali Mandir on Burhanath Road, Badi Kali Mandir at Mali Tola, Kali Mandirs on Hasanganj Road and Radha Devi Lane, and a Bari Kali Mandir at Auliabad/Kahalgaon in the district), so 'Kali Bari' is a generic name with no clear referent. This file documents Barmasia Kali Mandir on Burhanath Road as the most likely city-centre candidate, using its place-data coordinates - the identity match is unverified. No documented history, founding date, or timings exist for this shrine; details below are approximate or withheld rather than invented.

town_description: Bhagalpur is a major city on the southern bank of the Ganges in eastern Bihar and the historic capital of the Anga mahajanapada; it is known as India's 'Silk City' for its tussar-silk industry.

travel.railway: Bhagalpur Junction is the nearest major railway station (Eastern Railway).
travel.road: Well connected by road via NH-80 to Patna and neighbouring cities.
